title: SurgiCLAW: An Interpretable Atomic-Skill Agent for Precision Robotic Micromanipulation
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and vision--language--action models have provided robots with new capabilities for long-horizon task understanding and planning. In surgical robotics, however, end-to-end prediction of low-level actions remains limited by insufficient precision, opaque decisions, and scarce data. This paper presents SurgiCLAW, a hierarchical skill-based framework for precision surgical manipulation. SurgiCLAW confines an MLLM to intraoperative visual understanding, structured explanation, and atomic surgical-skill selection, while delegating physical execution to verifiable deterministic control programs. For brain--machine-interface implantation, a representative high-precision surgical task, we construct a state-to-skill invocation dataset and expand it through visual and state perturbations. The model first learns structured skill invocation through supervised fine-tuning and is then optimized using three rewards for action correctness, operation prerequisites, and format validity, improving action selection, operational safety, and output parseability. We evaluate subtask success, offline model comparison, real-robot performance, and ablations. On a fixed test set, SurgiCLAW achieves 94.6% skill-selection accuracy and 93.0% macro-averaged F1 (Macro-F1). Across 50 closed-loop real-robot implantation trials, it achieves an 88.0% task success rate.
tldr: SurgiCLAW is a hierarchical skill-based framework for precision robotic surgical micromanipulation, where an MLLM handles visual understanding and atomic skill selection while deterministic control programs execute actions, achieving high success in real-robot brain-machine-interface implantation trials.
tldr_zh: SurgiCLAW 是一种面向精密机器人显微操作的分层技能框架，由 MLLM 负责视觉理解与原子技能选择，并由确定性控制程序执行动作，在真实脑机接口植入试验中取得了较高的成功率。
summary_zh: 摘要：近期出现的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）以及视觉-语言-动作模型为机器人赋予了长时程任务理解与规划的新能力。然而，在手术机器人领域，对低层动作的端到端预测仍受制于精度不足、决策不透明以及数据稀缺等问题。本文提出了SurgiCLAW，一种面向精准手术操作的层次化技能型框架。SurgiCLAW将多模态大语言模型限定于术中视觉理解、结构化解释和原子化手术技能选择，而将物理执行交由可验证的确定性控制程序完成。以脑机接口植入这一典型高精度手术任务为例，我们构建了一个“状态到技能调用”数据集，并通过视觉与状态扰动对其进行扩充。模型首先通过监督微调学习结构化技能调用，随后使用三项奖励（动作正确性、操作前提条件、格式有效性）进行优化，从而改善动作选择、操作安全性和输出可解析性。我们评估了子任务成功率、离线模型对比、真实机器人性能以及消融实验。在固定测试集上，SurgiCLAW实现了94.6%的技能选择准确率和93.0%的宏平均F1分数（Macro-F1）。在50次闭环真实机器人植入试验中，其任务成功率达到88.0%。

title: SurgCast: Action-Conditioned Future Skeletons for Controllable Surgical World Models
summary: Surgical world models must turn prospective robot actions into visually faithful, structurally consistent instrument motion. We introduce SurgCast, which predicts future instrument skeletons from current structure, robot state, and future actions, then uses the forecast to control video generation. Dual-path injection combines skeleton geometry with derived, instrument-specific motion descriptors through geometric residuals and conditioning modulation. Both paths complement native action conditioning and are retained in a four-step causal student. On SutureBot and SRTH-Porcine-Cholei, the teacher and student improve all seven reported quality and instrument-consistency metrics over their respective direct-action baselines; teacher FVD decreases by 37.6% and 67.3%. Ablations show that future actions improve skeleton prediction and that combining both injection paths performs best across all six metrics under predicted skeletons. These results support using predicted articulated structure and its motion semantics as a control interface for surgical video prediction. Project videos and examples are available at https://surgcast.netlify.app/.
tldr: SurgCast introduces a surgical world model that predicts future instrument skeletons from current structure, robot state, and future actions, then uses these predicted skeletons and motion descriptors to condition video generation, improving quality and instrument consistency over direct-action baselines on surgical datasets.
tldr_zh: SurgCast 提出了一种手术世界模型，根据当前结构、机器人状态和未来动作预测未来器械骨架，并利用预测骨架及其运动描述符来控制视频生成，在手术数据集上相比直接动作条件基线提升了视频质量与器械一致性。
summary_zh: 外科手术世界模型必须将预期的机器人动作转化为视觉上逼真、结构上一致的器械运动。我们提出了SurgCast，它从当前结构、机器人状态和未来动作中预测未来的器械骨架，然后利用该预测来控制视频生成。双路径注入通过几何残差和条件调制，将骨架几何与导出的器械特定运动描述符相结合。两条路径均补充了原生动作条件，并保留在一个四步因果学生模型中。在SutureBot和SRTH-Porcine-Cholei数据集上，教师模型和学生模型相比各自对应的直接动作基线，在全部七项报告的质量和器械一致性指标上均有所提升；教师模型的FVD分别降低了37.6%和67.3%。消融实验表明，未来动作能改善骨架预测，而在预测骨架条件下，结合两条注入路径在全部六项指标上表现最佳。这些结果支持将预测的关节结构及其运动语义作为外科手术视频预测的控制接口。项目视频和示例见 https://surgcast.netlify.app/。

title: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Safety-Aware Haptic Shared Control in Surgical Robotics
summary: Haptic shared control in surgical robotics combines human-side and robot-side forces at a shared end effector while preserving operator involvement. However, the effects of geometric safety choices on task execution and force coordination remain unclear. We model the interaction as a two-agent cooperative Markov game under centralized training and decentralized execution, comparing learned human control with a task-tuned fixed-impedance baseline. This model-free multi-agent reinforcement learning framework supports joint policy adaptation without requiring a complete analytical interaction model. It compares MADDPG and rMAPPO with an epigraph-constrained approach under common geometric task definitions. In simulation, rMAPPO generally achieved the highest return and tracking performance, whereas the epigraph approach produced more conservative motions and lower geometric exposure, including no observed collision or dangerous-region exposure after geometry transfer. With real operator input, fixed-impedance-trained policies were faster and successful in all recorded trials. Policies trained with a learned partner exhibited greater command opposition, while the fixed epigraph condition produced the most aligned commands. This work provides a benchmark for studying human-control representation and constraint-handling trade-offs in haptic shared control.
tldr: Presents a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for safety-aware haptic shared control in surgical robotics, modeling human-robot cooperation as a two-agent Markov game with centralized training and decentralized execution, and comparing MADDPG, rMAPPO, and epigraph-constrained policies in simulation and with real operator input.
tldr_zh: 提出一种用于手术机器人安全感知触觉共享控制的多智能体强化学习框架，将人机协作建模为双智能体马尔可夫博弈，采用集中训练与分散执行，并在仿真和真实操作者输入下比较MADDPG、rMAPPO和epigraph约束策略。
summary_zh:
摘要：
触觉共享控制在手术机器人中，在共享末端执行器处结合了人与机器人两侧的力，同时保持操作者的参与。然而，几何安全选择对任务执行和力协调的影响仍不明确。我们将该交互建模为在集中训练与分散执行下的双智能体合作马尔可夫博弈，并将学习得到的人类控制与任务调优的固定阻抗基线进行比较。该无模型多智能体强化学习框架支持联合策略自适应，而无需完整的解析交互模型。在常见几何任务定义下，它将MADDPG和rMAPPO与一种上境图约束方法进行了比较。仿真中，rMAPPO通常获得最高的回报和跟踪性能，而上境图方法产生更保守的运动和更低的几何暴露，包括在几何转移后未观察到碰撞或危险区域暴露。在使用真实操作者输入时，基于固定阻抗训练的策略在所有记录试验中均更快且全部成功。与学习型伙伴共同训练的策略表现出更大的指令对抗，而固定上境图条件产生最一致的指令。这项工作为研究触觉共享控制中的人机控制表示和约束处理权衡提供了基准。

title: An Open MuJoCo Simulation Framework for a Quadrotor Carrying a Tendon-Driven Soft Continuum Arm
summary: Combining aerial robots with soft continuum manipulators promises safe, compliant interaction with the environment, but the coupled dynamics of a free-flying base and a highly deformable, underactuated arm are difficult to study without a suitable simulator. This paper describes an open-source simulation framework, built on the MuJoCo physics engine, for a quadrotor that carries a tendon-driven soft continuum arm underneath its body. The arm is modelled as a pseudo-rigid-body chain of twelve segments joined by pairs of orthogonal compliant hinges. Three tendons, spaced \SI{120}{\degree} apart and routed through every segment, bend it in any direction. A geometric tracking controller on $SE(3)$ flies the vehicle; its rotor allocation matrix is generated directly from the model description. A closed-form tendon-tension allocation keeps every tension within its limits and gives the same bending moment in every direction. We report the full set of modelling choices and parameters, and we evaluate the framework in four simulated scenarios: a \SI{36}{\second} mission with a figure-eight and a tendon-driven tip sweep, an attitude-gain study, a quasi-static characterization of the bending workspace, and an impulsive disturbance applied to the arm tip. With the nominal gains the vehicle tracks the mission with \SI{3.1}{\centi\meter} RMS position error while the arm tip swings up to \SI{37}{\centi\meter} from the body axis. The gain study shows that a low-bandwidth attitude loop lets the arm excite sustained oscillations. The simulation runs about $15\times$ faster than real time on a laptop CPU. All models, controllers and scripts that reproduce the figures are released.
tldr: An open-source MuJoCo simulation framework for a quadrotor carrying a tendon-driven soft continuum arm, featuring a pseudo-rigid-body arm model, SE(3) geometric flight control, closed-form tendon tension allocation, and multi-scenario evaluations including a 36-second mission.
tldr_zh: 一个基于MuJoCo的开源仿真框架，用于携带肌腱驱动软连续臂的四旋翼飞行器，包含伪刚体机械臂建模、SE(3)几何跟踪控制器、肌腱张力分配以及多项仿真评估。
summary_zh: 摘要：将空中机器人与软体连续体机械臂相结合，有望实现与环境的安全、柔顺交互，但自由飞行基座与高度可变形、欠驱动机械臂之间的耦合动力学，在没有合适仿真器的情况下难以研究。本文描述了一个基于MuJoCo物理引擎的开源仿真框架，用于仿真一架在机体下方搭载绳驱软体连续体机械臂的四旋翼飞行器。机械臂被建模为由十二段通过成对正交柔性铰链连接而成的伪刚体链。三根 tendons（腱绳）间隔120°布置，并穿过每一段，可使机械臂向任意方向弯曲。一个基于SE(3)的几何跟踪控制器控制飞行器飞行；其旋翼分配矩阵直接从模型描述中生成。一种闭式腱绳张力分配方法将每根腱绳的张力限制在允许范围内，并在各方向上产生相同的弯矩。我们报告了完整的建模选择和参数集，并在四个仿真场景中评估了该框架：一个包含八字轨迹和腱绳驱动末端扫掠的36秒任务、姿态增益研究、弯曲工作空间的准静态表征，以及对机械臂末端施加的冲量扰动。在标称增益下，飞行器跟踪任务的RMS位置误差为3.1厘米，而机械臂末端相对机体轴的最大摆幅达37厘米。增益研究表明，低带宽姿态环会让机械臂激发持续振荡。该仿真在笔记本电脑CPU上的运行速度约为实时速度的15倍。所有用于复现图表的模型、控制器和脚本均已发布。

title: Hand2Robot: Object-Centric 4D Hand Reconstruction from Human Demonstrations for Robotics
summary: Human demonstrations can capture task-relevant manipulation without using the target robot, but the recorded hand motions cannot directly serve as robot action supervision. Hand reconstruction and motion retargeting provide a direct route to such supervision, yet recovering hand motion alone does not ensure physically consistent hand-object interactions. To address this issue, we introduce Hand2Robot, an object-centric 4D hand reconstruction framework for robot policy post-training. Given videos of humans performing the target task, Hand2Robot extracts interaction clips, reconstructs object geometry, and generates robot action supervision through hand-object interaction optimization and motion retargeting. For object tracking, we combine observation confidence with temporal motion constraints to select a globally consistent object pose trajectory from per-frame pose candidates. For hand refinement, we use object geometry and motion as a reference and combine staged 2D alignment with object-local contact constraints to refine hand trajectories and finger joint configurations. Experiments on DexYCB and HO3D-v3 show improved object pose accuracy and hand-object interaction quality. Experiments on three real-robot dexterous manipulation tasks further show that reconstructed and retargeted human demonstrations can effectively supplement limited robot data for target-task policy post-training.
tldr: Hand2Robot reconstructs object-centric 4D hand motion from human demonstration videos and retargets it into robot action supervision, improving dexterous manipulation policies when robot data are limited.
tldr_zh: Hand2Robot 从人类演示视频中重建以物体为中心的四维手部运动，并通过运动重定向生成机器人动作监督信号，在机器人数据有限时提升灵巧操作策略。
summary_zh: 人类演示能够在不使用目标机器人的情况下捕获与任务相关的操作，但记录的手部动作不能直接作为机器人动作监督。手部重建和动作重定向为这种监督提供了一条直接途径，然而仅恢复手部运动并不能确保物理上一致的手-物交互。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Hand2Robot，一种面向对象的4D手部重建框架，用于机器人策略后训练。给定人类执行目标任务的视频，Hand2Robot提取交互片段，重建物体几何，并通过手-物交互优化和动作重定向生成机器人动作监督。在物体跟踪方面，我们将观测置信度与时间运动约束相结合，从逐帧姿态候选中选择全局一致的物体姿态轨迹。在手部细化方面，我们以物体几何和运动为参考，将分阶段2D对齐与物体局部接触约束相结合，以细化手部轨迹和手指关节配置。在DexYCB和HO3D-v3上的实验表明，物体姿态精度和手-物交互质量均有所提升。在三个真实机器人灵巧操作任务上的实验进一步表明，重建并重定向后的人类演示能够有效补充有限的机器人数据，用于目标任务策略的后训练。
